name: prompty
comment: Next Term's own grammar for Prompty files (MIT, like the rest of Next Term): YAML front matter, role lines that start each message, and a Jinja body.

frontMatter.comment: \A only matches on a file's first line, also when lines are tokenized one at a time.

reference.comment: key: ${env:NAME} or ${file:path}, a value filled in when the prompt runs. A whole-line rule ahead of YAML, whose plain-scalar rule would otherwise take the $.

role.comment: A line such as system:, user: or # assistant: starts the next message.

heading.comment: Markdown headings inside a message; template tags in them keep their colours.
heading.name: markup.heading.prompty
